name: io.github.tonyyang0504/crisp-mcp
description: Crisp (messaging): me, list_inbound, get_thread, reply, mark_read. Every tool maps to a documented e

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_CRISP_IDENTIFIER
environmentVariables.description: Identifier half of the Crisp token keypair (plugin token from the Marketplace, or a website token), sent as the HTTP Basic username — 'Authorization: Basic BASE64(identifier:key)' (https://docs.crisp.chat/guides/rest-api/authentication/plugin-token/, https://docs.crisp.chat/guides/rest-api/authentication/website-token/).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_CRISP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key half of the Crisp token keypair, sent as the HTTP Basic password ('--user "{identifier}:{key}"' in the official curl examples).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_CRISP_WEBSITE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Crisp website (workspace) identifier that prefixes every route (/website/{website_id}/...). Env: PLATFORM_MCP_CRISP_WEBSITE_ID.
